title: Library panel: sorting, filtering, search, and folder management
description: Improve the LibraryPanel.tsx component with Flash 8 library features: (1) Search/filter input at the top that filters items by name in real-time; (2) Sortable column headers: Name, Type, Use Count (click to sort asc/desc); (3) Folder tree view: library items can be placed in LibraryFolders; show folder rows with expand/collapse triangles; items inside folders indented; drag item to folder; (4) Context menu on right-click: Rename, Duplicate, Move to New Folder, Delete, Properties (shows linkage dialog); (5) New Folder button creates a LibraryFolder; (6) Item type icons: movie clip icon (⬜), button icon (⬡), graphic icon (△), bitmap icon (🖼), sound icon (♪), font icon (A), video icon (▶); (7) Selection highlight on click, multi-select with Ctrl/Shift; (8) Use count: count how many times each library item is referenced as SymbolInstance across all scene timelines. This is self-contained in LibraryPanel.tsx + possibly LibraryFolderDialog.tsx — check if Shell.tsx already passes the needed callbacks (onRenameLibraryItem, onDeleteLibraryItem, etc) before adding new props. See docs/08-library-assets.md.
